integrity: All stated counts derive from complete enumerations of 43,046,721 labelled configurations per graph with two independently coded functional-graph algorithms; four-cycle graph-symmetry classes are verified separately. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite enumeration of two 16-vertex three-state systems; not a theorem for arbitrary strongly regular graphs or larger state alphabets. Historical-equivalence risk remains.
title: Four-cycle excitation clocks distinguish the Shrikhande and rook graphs
